title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented Luther College study environments, from library rooms and workstations to campus and residence-hall lounges.

cards.entity_name: Preus Library Upper-Level Open Study Area
cards.title: Preus Library’s Upper-Level Open Study Area
cards.subtitle: Preus Library · upper level
cards.notes: Bring independent reading or writing to the upper level, where Preus documents open study areas and notes that upper levels tend to be quieter.
cards.short_summary: A quieter open-floor option above Preus Library’s main level.
cards.evidence_claim: Preus Library has Wi-Fi-enabled open study areas on all three floors; its upper and lower levels tend to be quieter.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted Preus Library building hours; check the library hours page for daily and term schedules.

cards.entity_name: Preus Library Lower-Level Open Study Area
cards.title: Preus Library’s Lower-Level Open Study Area
cards.subtitle: Preus Library · lower level
cards.notes: Set up on the lower level for focused solo work. The library identifies open study areas there and describes lower levels as tending to be quieter.
cards.short_summary: Open lower-level seating in Preus Library’s quieter zone.
cards.evidence_claim: Preus Library provides Wi-Fi-enabled open study areas on all three floors, and says its lower level tends to be quieter.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted Preus Library building hours; check the library hours page for daily and term schedules.

cards.title: Preus Library’s Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Preus Library
cards.notes: Ask at the circulation desk for a key when you need a contained study setting; the library lists keys for individual and group study rooms.
cards.short_summary: Key-access individual rooms for focused library work.
cards.evidence_claim: Preus Library offers individual study rooms, and its circulation desk provides keys for individual and group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Room keys are obtained through the Circulation Desk; use during posted library hours.

cards.title: Preus Library’s Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Preus Library
cards.notes: Coordinate a project meeting, then obtain a room key from circulation. Luther lists small group rooms among the library’s study facilities.
cards.short_summary: A library room option for project partners and small groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Preus Library has small group study rooms, and the Circulation Desk provides keys for group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Preus Library | Luther College Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: Obtain a group-study-room key from the Circulation Desk; use during posted library hours.

cards.title: Preus Library Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Preus Library · main level
cards.notes: Use the main-level computer lab when your coursework needs a campus workstation. The virtual tour identifies it as the college’s largest computer lab.
cards.short_summary: Main-level workstations in Luther’s largest computer lab.
cards.evidence_claim: Preus Library’s main level contains a computer lab, described by Luther as the largest computer lab on campus.
cards.source_title: Preus Library | Luther College Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: Located on Preus Library’s main level; library building hours govern access.

cards.title: Digital Media Center Lab
cards.subtitle: Preus Library · lower level
cards.notes: Choose the lab for photo, video, or media-editing coursework. Luther says the lab is an open learning space with high-end Macs for these projects.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level media-work lab for digital projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Digital Media Center’s lower-level multimedia lab is an open learning space with high-end Macs for photo, media, and video editing.
cards.access_notes: The DMC Lab is available whenever Preus Library is open; the DMC Studio requires an appointment.

cards.title: Language Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Main Building 215
cards.notes: Use Main 215 for language coursework or a small-group session. The center provides films, print resources, a computer lab, and private study areas.
cards.short_summary: Language resources and study areas in Main 215.
cards.evidence_claim: Luther’s Language Learning Center in Main 215 offers private study rooms and areas, a computer lab, films, print resources, and space for small groups.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday; Luther states students are welcome whenever the door is open.

cards.title: Koren Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Koren Hall
cards.notes: Head to Koren when you want a study lounge near social-science classrooms and offices. Luther explicitly states the lounge is available to all students.
cards.short_summary: An all-student study lounge in historic Koren Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Koren Hall has a study lounge available for all students.
cards.access_notes: Located in Koren Hall; no separate public lounge hours are stated on the source page.

cards.title: Brunsdale Lounge
cards.subtitle: Between Miller and Dieseth Halls
cards.notes: If you live in the Towers, use Brunsdale’s study setting between Miller and Dieseth. Luther identifies it as a social meeting place and study location.
cards.short_summary: A Towers lounge with dedicated study use.
cards.evidence_claim: Brunsdale Lounge connects Miller and Dieseth Halls and functions as both a social meeting place and a study location.
cards.source_title: Miller and Dieseth Halls (Towers) | Luther College
cards.access_notes: Located within the Miller–Dieseth Towers residence-hall complex; confirm building access with Residence Life.

cards.title: Farwell Hall Top-Floor Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Farwell Hall · top floor
cards.notes: For a longer indoor work session, use Farwell’s top-floor study lounge, which Luther documents with a kitchen, fireplace, and scenic view.
cards.short_summary: A top-floor residence-hall lounge designed for study and social use.
cards.evidence_claim: Farwell Hall has a large top-floor study/social lounge with a kitchen, fireplace, and scenic view.
cards.access_notes: Inside Farwell Hall; confirm residence-hall guest and building-access rules with Residence Life.
